provenance_note: All client/vendor/human/address/copy data excluded; vertical retained; copy structure only.

program_model.instance_model: one modular extrusion sized by part-number; copy method varies (ADA-integral tactile / screen-print / laser paper insert / magnetic)

knowledge.plain_language_summary: The dominant interior family: a proprietary 'Modular Thin' aluminum extrusion profile sized by part number, holding a painted ABS insert. Copy method varies by code: ADA integral raised tactile + braille for permanent room IDs, screen-printed inserts, laser-printed paper inserts, or a magnetic backer for changeable workstation IDs.
knowledge.rationale: One extrusion system with swappable insert technologies (tactile / printed / paper / magnetic) reproduces a whole campus program at scale while isolating the changeable copy from the permanent ADA portion.

structure.construction: Modular Thin aluminum extrusion (part numbers 4X4A/2X4A/2X6A/6X8A/3X11VA/14X18) with square-corner aluminum end caps; painted ABS insert seated in extrusion
per code: integral raised tactile + Grade-2 braille (ADA room IDs); screen-printed insert; laser-printed paper insert behind face; or magnetic backer (changeable workstation ID)

dimensions.note: panels ~3-18in tall; huge QTY (room IDs 31-670, workstation 1158)

compliance.notes: Permanent room IDs carry integral raised tactile + braille; latch-side mounting; 60in baseline.

craft_observations: One extrusion, four copy technologies (ADA-integral / screen / paper / magnetic) is the cost driver and the variant axis.
Magnetic backer on workstation IDs enables high churn without reprinting panels.

modeling_notes: ~25 sign-type codes collapsed to one modular-extrusion archetype + message_schedule.
